## inquirer@14.2.3

### What's new

- Rolled up the prompt fixes from this release: `search()` stale-choice submission ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291)), `confirm()` always accepting `y`/`n` ([#2281](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2281)), `expand()`/`rawlist()` whitespace handling ([#2280](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2280)).
- All package READMEs now document the Deno install command ([#2269](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2269)).

### Dependencies

- `@inquirer/prompts` bumped to `^8.7.3`
- `@inquirer/core` bumped to `^12.0.4`

## @inquirer/type@4.2.0

### What's new

- New `withResolver<T>()` export: creates a promise together with its `resolve`/`reject` functions, replacing the manual `let resolve` boilerplate. Available until `Promise.withResolvers` (Node 22+) becomes the minimum supported version ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291)).

body.name: @inquirer/search@4.3.4
body.body:
## @inquirer/search@4.3.4

### What's new

- Pressing Enter while an async search is still loading no longer submits a stale choice from the previous query — a prompt showing Alberta now waits for the Quebec results instead of returning Alberta ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291), closes [#2290](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/2290)). The search term is preserved after an early Enter, and repeated Enter presses during validation no longer run the async validator more than once.

### Dependencies

- `@inquirer/type` bumped to `^4.2.0` — new `withResolver` export ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291))

- `@inquirer/type` bumped to `^4.2.0` — new `withResolver` export ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291))

## @inquirer/prompts@8.7.3

### What's new

- `search()` no longer submits a stale choice when Enter is pressed while an async search is still loading — the prompt waits for the fresh results, the query is preserved, and repeated Enter presses during validation no longer run the async validator more than once (`@inquirer/search`, [#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291), closes [#2290](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/2290)).
- `confirm()` now always accepts the single keystrokes `y`/`n` even with localized keywords, and unrecognized input no longer silently falls back on the default answer (`@inquirer/confirm`, [#2281](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2281), closes [#2279](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/2279)).
- `expand()` and `rawlist()` now ignore surrounding whitespace in answers (`@inquirer/expand`, `@inquirer/rawlist`, [#2280](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2280)).
- All package READMEs now document the Deno install command (`deno add npm:@inquirer/prompts`) alongside the npm/yarn/pnpm/bun ones ([#2269](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2269)).

## @inquirer/confirm@6.3.3

### What's new

- The single keystrokes `y`/`n` are now always accepted, even when localized keywords (e.g. Chinese 是/否) are configured — theme keywords keep precedence when matching ([#2281](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2281), closes [#2279](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/2279)).
- Unrecognized input no longer silently falls back on the default answer: the prompt stays active, shows an error and lets the user retry.

### Dependencies

- `@inquirer/type` bumped to `^4.2.0` — new `withResolver` export ([#2291](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2291))

## inquirer@14.2.2

The umbrella package, bundling `@inquirer/prompts` and `@inquirer/core`.

### What's new

- Fixed a race where keystrokes batched in the same tick as the key that settled a prompt could still reach keypress handlers after the prompt was done, cancelled, or aborted (`@inquirer/core`, [#2255](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2255), closes [#1816](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/1816)).
- `confirm()` now trims surrounding whitespace from answers before matching yes/no keywords (`@inquirer/confirm`, [#2254](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2254)).

### Included

- `@inquirer/core@^12.0.3`
- `@inquirer/prompts@^8.7.2`

## @inquirer/core@12.0.3

### What's new

- Fixed a race where keystrokes batched in the same tick as the key that settled a prompt could still reach `useKeypress` handlers after the prompt was done, cancelled, or aborted. Hook effects are now cleared in the synchronous settlement path ([#2255](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2255), closes [#1816](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/1816)).
- Prompts created with an already-aborted signal now run the terminal cleanup (restore the cursor, close the readline interface, end the output stream) instead of leaking them ([#2255](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2255)).

body.body:
## @sboudrias/package@1.0.3

Release tooling package.

### What's new

- New `package pin <dependency>` command rewrites caret/tilde ranges to exact versions across public packages; the release pipeline uses it to pin `@inquirer/type` in published manifests ([#2247](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2247)).
- New `package normalize` command applies the fixups required to make manifests valid for npm publishing. It replaces the inline jq step that stripped `workspace:*` devDependencies (byte-identical output, now also covering the published `tools/*` packages).
- Commands live in task folders (`index.ts` + `command.ts`, tests colocated); `bin.ts` only assembles the CLI.

body.name: @inquirer/testing@3.3.12
body.body:
## @inquirer/testing@3.3.12

### What's new

- Keypress simulation now works under `TERM=dumb`. Node's readline disables all line editing (backspace, arrows, etc.) when `TERM=dumb`, regardless of whether input is a real terminal — environments like GitLab CI or Emacs shells set it, silently breaking `events.keypress()` in test suites. `prompt()` now overrides `TERM` for the readline interface construction alone ([#2246](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2246), fixes [#2180](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/issues/2180)).
- Published manifests now pin `@inquirer/type` to an exact version ([#2247](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2247)).

## inquirer@14.1.0

The umbrella package, bundling `@inquirer/prompts` and `@inquirer/core`.

### What's new

- Updated to `@inquirer/prompts@^8.6.0` and `@inquirer/core@^12.0.0`.
- Includes the new `initialValue` option for `search`, floating-point step fixes for `number`, and explicit-`undefined` default handling in `number`/`confirm`/`editor`.

### ⚠️ Note on `@inquirer/core@12`

`inquirer@14.1.0` depends on `@inquirer/core@^12.0.0`, which changed the `useState` setter to accept a reducer function `(currentValue) => nextValue`. This is a type-level change for consumers of the core hook API (relevant if you build custom prompts with `@inquirer/core`). The built-in prompts are unaffected.

### Included

- `@inquirer/core@^12.0.0`
- `@inquirer/prompts@^8.6.0`
- `@inquirer/type@^4.0.7`
- `@inquirer/ansi@^2.0.7`

## @inquirer/prompts@8.6.0

The all-in-one prompts package, re-exporting every individual prompt at its latest version.

### Highlights

This release rides on **`@inquirer/core@12.0.0`**, which makes the `useState` setter accept a reducer/updater function. It also brings a new `initialValue` option to search, plus fixes for `number`, `confirm`, and `editor`.

### What's new

- **`@inquirer/search`** — new `initialValue?: string` option to pre-fill the search input ([#2205](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2205))

### What's fixed

- **`@inquirer/number`** — avoid floating-point step errors; accept explicit `undefined` as default ([#2166](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2166), [#2182](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2182))
- **`@inquirer/confirm`** — accept explicit `undefined` as default ([#2182](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2182))
- **`@inquirer/editor`** — accept explicit `undefined` as default ([#2182](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2182))

### Included prompts

- `@inquirer/checkbox@5.2.2`
- `@inquirer/confirm@6.2.0`
- `@inquirer/editor@5.3.0`
- `@inquirer/expand@5.1.2`
- `@inquirer/input@5.1.3`

- `@inquirer/password@5.1.2`
- `@inquirer/rawlist@5.3.2`
- `@inquirer/search@4.3.0`
- `@inquirer/select@5.2.2`

> **Note:** This release depends on `@inquirer/core@^12.0.0`, which contains a breaking change to the `useState` setter type (it now accepts a reducer function). See the `@inquirer/core@12.0.0` release notes for details.

## @inquirer/core@12.0.0

### ⚠️ Breaking change

The setter returned by `useState` now accepts an updater/reducer function `(currentValue) => nextValue`, mirroring React. The updater always receives the latest state (read from the hook store at call time), which simplifies async and reducer-style state updates.

**Type change:** the setter signature moves from `(newValue: Value) => void` to `(newValue: NotFunction<Value> | Reducer<Value>) => void`.

**Impact:** any code that stored a *function as a value* via `useState`'s setter now has that function interpreted as a reducer. This is a type-level breaking change for consumers of the core hook API.

### What's new

- `useState` setter accepts a reducer function `(currentValue) => nextValue` ([#2225](https://github.com/SBoudrias/Inquirer.js/pull/2225))

### Dependencies

- `@inquirer/figures` bumped to `^2.0.8`
